headnotes.text: Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 21 allows a court to add or drop a party at any time, including on appeal. An appellate court may therefore vacate and remand with instructions to reinstate a previously dismissed defendant, even one not required under Rule 19, to avoid multiple unnecessary proceedings before certifying unresolved state-law questions.
